scope: committed source inspection of comparator facet and numeric witness admission only; no compiler execution or native Truss adoption
facts: integer facets must be exactly integerWidth with bits/signed; bits 1..64
decimal facets must be exactly precision/scale; precision 1..28, unsigned scale <= precision
unknown or additional min/max facets refuse current comparator parse
numeric witness exponent uses checked i64 arithmetic; fraction_digits u64 admitted through i64 conversion
numeric witness budget reserves 4*digit_count+8 per occurrence before normalization
